surface: U-F1 resource ceiling / peak simultaneous memory of Strassen-Winograd recursion
deviations_from_task_text: The task named 'the hosted memory margin our own record notes (1.445 MiB)' as comparator (a). That margin is against a 512-MiB gate that HOSTED_INTEL_20260808.md:52-54 records as SELF-IMPOSED, superseded by a browser-read official facts panel giving the grader 64 GB. I therefore measured against BOTH ceilings and report both, rather than treating 512 MiB as the ceiling.

I did not rely on the recorded 510.555-MiB champion peak implied by the 1.445-MiB margin. I MEASURED the champion's peak working set first-hand on a synthetic He net (452.312 / 452.691 MiB over two runs). The measured value is MORE favourable to the claim than the recorded one, so using it is the conservative choice for a kill attempt.
psutil is not installed in whest-v014; process memory is read with ctypes K32GetProcessMemoryInfo (PeakWorkingSetSize / PeakPagefileUsage), the same 'peak working set' quantity the corpus quotes.

derived_and_measured_footprints.method: batched all-levels-live row-blocked Strassen-Winograd, BLOCK_ROWS=4096, width 256, float32. Level l holds 7^l left/product stacks of (rows/2^l, w/2^l) and a 7^l right stack of (w/2^l)^2, i.e. (7/4)^l*(2*R*W + W^2) elements; all levels are simultaneously live because a level's batched matmul consumes the whole 7^l stack in one call.

cross_checks.vs_live_frozen_RowBlockedBatchedWinograd: left+right+products = 15,138,816 B, equals the d1 closed form exactly; buffer_bytes = 19,349,504 B; full_output_bytes = 0

depth_first_sw_product_at_production_M.note: U-F1's own metered implementation (uf1_derive_and_verify.py::sw_product) is depth-first and NOT row-blocked; U-F1 metered it at M=8064 'for wall/memory tractability'. I ran it at the full production M=64512.
depth_first_sw_product_at_production_M.bounded_not_exponential: temporaries converge to 4/3 of the level-0 term (geometric 4^-l), so the depth-first tree is O(M*K + M*N), not O((7/4)^d)

champion_measurement.net: synthetic He 256x256 x depth 32, seed 101, mlp.seed 901101 (construction copied from v31_guards/run_v31_gates.py::he_weights)
champion_measurement.determinism: billed FLOPs bitwise identical and output checksum identical across all six runs; ballast does not perturb the computation

vs_enforced_64GiB_ceiling.smallest_margin: 56.1x headroom at d=5 on peak commit

the_repair_that_defeats_the_kill.claim: the Strassen workspace is LINEAR in BLOCK_ROWS while the charged bill is EXACTLY BLOCK_ROWS-invariant, so any memory envelope is met at zero FLOP cost by shrinking the row block

measured_bill_invariance.equals_corpus_recorded_L1_bill: 7,427,768,320 / 8,439,201,792 = 0.880151, the value CODEX_HANDOFF_20260810.md:594 records for the committed batched formulation
measured_bill_invariance.caveat: the f32 result is NOT bitwise invariant to block height (summation order changes); the parity drift stays at 4.8e-7..5.4e-7, i.e. ~40x inside the frozen 2e-5 gate

the_repair_that_defeats_the_kill.cost_of_the_repair: row-loop wall only, which the corpus's own audit places in unbilled backend time: +23% at 1808 rows (0.2996 s vs 0.2438 s), +64% at 896 rows (0.3997 s). Zero charged FLOPs.

flopscope_per_call_ledger_finding.observation: flopscope retains roughly 2.6-3.5 KiB of accounting state per matmul call inside a BudgetContext, so a DEPTH-FIRST recursion with 7^d leaf calls pays a memory term that grows as 7^d.
flopscope_per_call_ledger_finding.why_it_does_not_bite: the fused BATCHED dispatch is O(1) in batch size: a single (16807,128,8)@(16807,8,8) call bills 258,155,520 (exact formula match), runs in 0.040 s, and its peak working set exceeds the stack bytes by only ~0.4 MiB. The production path is batched.

defect_found_in_the_claim_artifacts.severity: immaterial to the verdict, reported for honesty
defect_found_in_the_claim_artifacts.what: UF1_ACCOUNTING.md line 152-153 prose gives absolute charged FLOPs at M=64512 V1 as d3 5,840,555,008 / d4 5,309,760,256 / d5 5,000,676,352. Its own artifact uf1_results.json and my re-metered live flopscope run both give 5,840,523,264 / 5,309,811,712 / 5,000,639,744.
defect_found_in_the_claim_artifacts.impact: none on r(d) to 6 decimals; the headline ratios 0.878677 / 0.775951 / 0.692071 / 0.629184 / 0.592549 reproduce exactly from the artifact

what_would_have_to_be_true_to_kill_on_th: The 512-MiB envelope would have to be reinstated as a binding gate AND BLOCK_ROWS would have to be frozen at 4096 (it is a constructor argument, and the bill is provably invariant to it), OR
the enforced ceiling would have to fall below ~1.2 GiB of peak commit - it is 64 GiB, a 56x margin at the worst depth, OR

the level stacks would have to be forced M-proportional rather than BLOCK_ROWS-proportional, which would require abandoning row blocking; even then the depth-first tree measures 435 MiB peak at M=64512 d=5, still inside 512 MiB standalone.
